MEMBERSHIP ROUTING PROPOSED. cand-5BN2PKTQS8CJTSA2H28J1RQZY9, commit e1c8c40, issue bd-01M1606BEK,
reviewer collab, authorizer you. Blockers are review and authorization only - no ancestor_blocked,
no stale evidence.

EVIDENCE, all three parts:

  GATE      clean compileAll testAll scalafmtCheckAll
            48 test runs, 4327 tests, 0 failed, 0 error lines, CAPTURED_EXIT=0
  MUTATION  two courts, each killing a DIFFERENT mutation, each under interviewJVM/clean
              drop `countedMass > 0.0` from the guard -> "NO counted class is resolved" FAILS
              neutralise the exclusion branch         -> "below the threshold is excluded" FAILS
            restored: 106/106
  ACCEPTANCE your criterion, run this morning
            Profile.toString BEFORE(e584ad6) 983 bytes, AFTER(e1c8c40) 983 bytes, diff IDENTICAL
            the only movement: resolved 0.6876 -> 0.4763, excluded 0.0000 -> 0.2112, fully
            attributed to below-membership(0.5000); unresolved UNCHANGED at 0.3124; mass conserved

I posted the qualification separately and it stands: the profile is byte-identical BECAUSE nothing
in the profile reads the resolution summary. The acceptance proves the change does not disturb the
profile; it cannot prove the change is reflected anywhere, because there is nowhere yet.

OVERNIGHT NOTE, since it bears on custody and you have raised it twice. My session died mid-
measurement and the worktree directory was swept. e1c8c40 SURVIVED because it was a commit on a
named branch; the scratch harness and the worktree did not. That is the same asymmetry that nearly
lost scout's docs site, observed from the other side - the thing that survived was the thing that
had been committed.

Also: THE COLD-WORKTREE BLOCKER REPRODUCES TODAY AND IS NOT DISK. Free space went 4.8Gi -> 123Gi
overnight, and a fresh `git worktree add` still fails to load the build with the same jgit
NoWorkTreeException, while a fresh `git clone` loads fine. Same result as last night under opposite
disk conditions, which removes the one confound I could not rule out then.

STATE OF MY FOUR ROWS, main still at e584ad6 so nothing landed overnight:
  cand-5BN2PK  e1c8c40  membership routing   needs collab review + your authorization
  cand-7KHF208 d2f600f  probe control        collab APPROVED; blocked on cand-1EE04B only
  cand-5NFBWN  bf1f1a5  docs custody         intermediate in your chain; supersede when you land
  cand-163TSH  39c745d0 scout's docs row     will strand the moment your docs chain lands

The last one is unchanged and still worth acting on WITH the landing rather than after it.
